about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Dau Hu Sot Ca Chua Vietnamese Tofu in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Golden fried tofu simmered in a sweet, tangy tomato and spring onion sauce, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides, then lift out.
In the same pan fry the garlic and white spring onion for 1 minute until fragrant, add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until they collapse into a sauce.
Stir in the soy sauce, sugar, salt and pepper, return the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes until the sauce clings, then scatter the green spring onion and serve over the rice.
notes: Naturally vegan. Serve with extra black pepper.

recipes.title: Com Ga Hoi An Turmeric Chicken Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Hoi An style shredded chicken on turmeric rice with a sharp onion and herb relish.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it with the turmeric, a pinch of salt and the right amount of water until tender and fluffy.
Poach the chicken in simmering water for 18 minutes until cooked through, then lift out, cool for a few minutes and shred.
Toss the sliced onion with the lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce and the sugar and leave it to soften while the chicken cooks.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute until golden, add the shredded chicken and the remaining fish sauce and stir for 2 minutes until hot and lightly coloured.
Pile the chicken over the rice and top with the onion relish, mint and coriander.
notes: Food safety: poach the chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C, and wash hands and board after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Tahu Orek Javanese Sweet Soy Tofu
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu strips tossed in a sticky kecap manis, chilli and shallot glaze with green beans.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 9 minutes until deep golden and crisp, then lift out onto paper.
Add the remaining oil, fry the shallots, garlic and chilli for 2 minutes until soft, then add the beans and stir-fry for 3 minutes until bright and just tender.
Return the tofu with the kecap manis, tamarind and salt and toss for 2 minutes until glossy and sticky, then serve on the rice.
notes: Vegan if your kecap manis is. Check the label.

recipes.title: Laksa Lemak Tofu Puff Curry Noodles
recipes.summary: Rich coconut laksa paste noodles with fried tofu puffs, bean sprouts and lime, finished in one pot.
steps: Cover the vermicelli with boiling water for 5 minutes until just tender, drain and divide among four bowls.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and fry the laksa paste and shallots for 3 minutes until fragrant and the oil darkens.
Pour in the stock and coconut milk, add the sugar and simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the tofu puffs and simmer for 4 minutes until swollen and hot, then ladle over the noodles and top with sprouts, coriander and lime.
notes: Check the laksa paste for shrimp paste if you need it vegan.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer Spinach and Paneer Curry
recipes.summary: Silky spinach gravy with golden paneer cubes, spiced with cumin, garam masala and ginger.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute until bright green, drain, cool a little and blend to a coarse purée.
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a pan, fry the paneer for 4 minutes until golden on each side, then lift out.
Add the remaining ghee, fry the onion for 6 minutes until golden, add garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spinach, cream and salt, simmer for 5 minutes until thick, return the paneer and heat through before serving with the rice.
notes: Paneer is a fresh cheese and suits vegetarians.

recipes.title: Aloo Bodi Nepali Potato and Black-Eyed Pea Curry
recipes.summary: A tangy Nepali one-pot of potatoes, black-eyed peas and spinach with fenugreek and turmeric.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot until it shimmers, add the fenugreek seeds for 20 seconds, then the onion and fry for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the ginger, garlic and spices and stir for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they break down.
Add the potatoes, peas, salt and 1 1/2 cups water, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender, then fold in the spinach for 2 minutes until wilted and the sauce is thick.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Githeri Kenyan Maize and Bean Stew
recipes.summary: A hearty Kenyan one-pot of maize and kidney beans cooked with tomato, onion and a little coriander.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic and spices for 1 minute until fragrant, then the tomatoes and carrots and cook for 6 minutes until the tomatoes break down.
Add the beans, corn, stock and salt, cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the carrot is tender and the stew is thick.
Stir in half the coriander and serve scattered with the rest.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Long Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: Glass noodles simmered in ginger chicken broth with shiitake and spring onion, a Hawaiian luau favourite.

items: 500g chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, sliced
6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and sliced

steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for 10 minutes until pliable, drain and cut into shorter lengths.
Heat the oil in a wide pot, fry the ginger and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until no longer pink.
Add the stock, soy sauce, mushrooms and carrot and simmer for 8 minutes until the carrot is tender.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes until clear and soft, then stir in the spring onions and serve in bowls.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Tofu Steaks with Mushroom Soy Glaze
recipes.summary: Seared tofu slabs with a glossy mushroom, mirin and soy glaze over rice, a quick vegan Japanese dinner.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Pat the tofu dry, heat the oil in a wide pan and sear for 4 minutes each side until deep golden, then lift out.
Fry the mushrooms, ginger and garlic in the same pan for 4 minutes until browned and soft.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, vinegar, cornflour and 1/4 cup water, pour it in and simmer for 2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Return the tofu, spoon the glaze over, and serve on rice with spring onions.
notes: Naturally vegan. Use tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Yakisoba Japanese Festival Noodles
recipes.summary: Chewy noodles with cabbage, carrot and pork in a tangy sauce, finished with pickled ginger.
steps: Loosen the noodles under warm running water until separate and drain well.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 3 minutes until browned and cooked through, then lift out.
Add the remaining oil, stir-fry the onion, carrot and cabbage for 4 minutes until the cabbage is wilted and lightly charred.
Add the noodles and toss for 2 minutes, add the pork, sauces and sugar, and cook for 2 minutes until the noodles are glossy and hot.
Serve topped with pickled ginger.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 63°C in the thickest slice, then rest briefly. The pork should reach 75°C if you prefer it well done.

recipes.title: Rendang Cendawan Mushroom Curry
recipes.summary: Meaty mushrooms slow-cooked in a dry coconut and lemongrass rendang until it clings and darkens.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger and chillies into a paste, and tear the mushrooms into thick strips.
Fry the paste in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant, add the spices and lemongrass and stir for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms, coconut milk, tamarind and salt and simmer on low heat for 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick, dark and almost dry.
Remove the lemongrass and serve with the rice.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chongqing La Zi Ji Chilli Chicken Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp chicken pieces tossed with dried chillies and Sichuan pepper, with rice and cucumber on the side.

items: 700g chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, cut into bite pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, wine and cornflour until coated.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the chicken in two batches for 5 minutes each until deep golden and cooked through, then lift out.
Pour off most of the oil, add the chillies and peppercorns and stir for 30 seconds until they darken and smell sharp.
Add the garlic, ginger and chicken with the sugar and toss for 2 minutes until coated, then serve with the rice and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the thickest piece reaches 75°C, and wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Doubanjiang Braised Tofu Home Style
recipes.summary: Soft tofu simmered in chilli bean paste, garlic and spring onion, a quick Sichuan weeknight dish.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Simmer the tofu in salted water for 3 minutes until firm, then drain.
Fry the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger in the oil for 2 minutes until the oil turns red and fragrant.
Add 1 cup water, the soy sauce and sugar, then the tofu, and simmer for 6 minutes until the sauce reduces.
Stir in the cornflour mixed with water, cook for 1 minute until glossy, scatter over the spring onions and serve with rice.
notes: Naturally vegan.

recipes.title: Salted Egg Yolk Prawns with Rice
recipes.summary: Crisp prawns coated in a buttery salted egg yolk sauce with curry leaves and chilli.

items: 6 salted egg yolks, cooked and mashed

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Pat the prawns dry and toss in the cornflour until lightly coated.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the prawns for 3 minutes until pink and crisp, then lift out.
Pour off the oil, melt the butter, add the mashed yolks and cook for 1 minute until foamy.
Add the garlic, chilli and curry leaves for 30 seconds, return the prawns and toss until coated, then serve on rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until opaque and pink, and eggs fully cooked to 75°C. Keep raw prawns chilled.

recipes.title: Gochujang Glazed Salmon with Sesame Spinach Rice
recipes.summary: Salmon fillets roasted under a sweet-hot gochujang glaze, served on sesame rice with wilted spinach.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray. Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and vinegar.
Brush the glaze over the salmon and roast for 12 minutes until the flesh flakes and the glaze bubbles.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with the sesame oil for 2 minutes until soft, stir through the rice with the sesame seeds and serve with the salmon.
notes: Food safety: cook the salmon until the thickest part reaches 63°C.

recipes.title: Dwaeji Bulgogi Spicy Pork Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Gochujang-marinated pork stir-fried with onion and finished over rice with kimchi and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger and coat the pork.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over high heat and stir-fry the onion for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the pork in batches and cook for 6 minutes until browned, sticky and cooked through.
Serve over rice with the spring onions and kimchi.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw pork.

recipes.title: Gamjajorim Soy Braised Potatoes with Egg
recipes.summary: Baby potatoes and soft-boiled eggs glazed in a sweet soy braise, a staple of Korean home cooking.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until just firm, cool in cold water and peel.
Simmer the potatoes with 1 1/2 cups water, the soy sauce, sugar, garlic and chilli for 15 minutes until tender.
Add the eggs, syrup and sesame oil and simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce is glossy and thick, then serve on rice with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set and hold the dish above 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Khao Pad Sapparot Thai Pineapple Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Day-old rice stir-fried with pineapple, prawns, cashews and curry powder for a sweet-savoury dinner.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the prawns for 3 minutes until pink, then lift out.
Scramble the eggs in the wok for 1 minute until just set and break them up.
Add the remaining oil and the onion, cook for 2 minutes, then the rice and curry powder and stir for 3 minutes until hot and loose.
Add the pineapple, prawns, cashews, soy sauce and fish sauce and toss for 2 minutes until heated through.
Scatter over the spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until opaque and pink (63°C) and eggs until set, and cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gai Pad Med Mamuang Thai Cashew Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken stir-fried with roasted cashews, capsicum and dried chilli in a glossy oyster sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the chillies and garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes until cooked through and lightly golden.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 2 minutes until just tender, then the sauces and sugar until glossy.
Toss in the cashews and spring onions and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Pla Tod Khamin Thai Turmeric Fried Fish
recipes.summary: Crisp turmeric and garlic fish fillets with sweet chilli sauce and steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Rub the fish with the turmeric, garlic, pepper and salt, then dust with the rice flour.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the fish for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden and the flesh flakes.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce, lime and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until the thickest part reaches 63°C. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thit Kho Hot Vit Pork and Egg Braise
recipes.summary: Pork belly and boiled eggs braised in coconut water and caramel until tender and lacquered.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pot with the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until amber, add the shallots and garlic and the pork and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, pepper, coconut water and eggs, cover and simmer for 55 minutes until the pork is tender and the sauce is syrupy, then serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook pork to 75°C throughout and eggs until fully set. Refrigerate leftovers promptly.

recipes.title: Ayam Penyet Smashed Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Spiced fried chicken smashed with a fiery sambal, with cucumber and rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Simmer the drumsticks in 2 cups water with the turmeric, garlic, coriander and salt for 20 minutes until cooked through, then drain and dry.
Fry the chicken in the hot oil for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden.
Blend the chillies, tomatoes and shallots into a sambal with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Smash the chicken lightly, cover with sambal and serve with cucumber and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone, and wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Ikan Assam Pedas Malaysian Sour Fish Curry
recipes.summary: Fish simmered in a tamarind, chilli and lemongrass gravy with okra and tomato.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the chillies, shallots, garlic and ginger to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add 3 cups water, the lemongrass, tamarind, sugar and salt and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the okra and tomatoes for 4 minutes until tender, then lay the fish in and cook for 6 minutes until opaque and flaky.
Serve the fish and its sour gravy with the rice and a little extra tamarind at the table.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until the thickest part reaches 63°C. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Curry Mee Mamak Style Noodles
recipes.summary: Egg noodles in a spicy coconut curry with tofu puffs, potato and bean sprouts.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic and ginger and fry in the oil for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Add the curry powder and sambal and stir for 1 minute, then the stock, coconut milk and potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the tofu puffs and simmer for 4 minutes until hot.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes until tender and drain.
Divide the noodles among bowls, ladle the curry over and top with bean sprouts.
notes: Contains egg and wheat.

recipes.title: Bhindi Masala Dry Okra Curry
recipes.summary: Crisp-tender okra with onion, tomato and cumin, served with rice and dal.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan and fry the okra for 8 minutes until browned and no longer sticky, then lift out.
Add the remaining oil, cumin seeds and onions and cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the spices, tomatoes and chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes until thick, then return the okra with the salt and amchur and cook for 3 minutes until tender.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Kadai Paneer Peppers and Paneer
recipes.summary: Paneer and capsicum in a spicy coarse-ground kadai masala gravy.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the ghee in a kadai or wide pan and toast the coriander and chillies for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the onion, ginger and garlic and cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the tomatoes and salt and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Fold in the capsicums, paneer and garam masala and cook for 4 minutes until the capsicum is tender and the paneer is hot.
notes: Paneer is a fresh cheese and suits vegetarians.

recipes.title: Matoke Plantain and Peanut Stew
recipes.summary: Green plantain simmered with tomato, onion and ground peanut, a Ugandan comfort one-pot.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the onion for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the plantain, ground peanuts, salt and stock, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the plantain is tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the coriander and taste for salt before serving the stew hot.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Wali wa Nazi Coconut Rice with Pigeon Peas
recipes.summary: Swahili coconut rice cooked with pigeon peas, cardamom and tomato, served with a lime kachumbari.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the cardamom.
Add the rinsed rice, coconut milk, 1 1/2 cups water and salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and fluffy.
Fold in the pigeon peas, cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Toss the tomatoes with the lime juice and coriander and serve on top.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Boerewors and Pap with Tomato Gravy
recipes.summary: Browned boerewors with a spiced tomato and onion gravy over soft maize pap.
steps: Bring 3 cups salted water to the boil, whisk in the maize meal and cook on low for 20 minutes until thick and soft.
Fry the boerewors in the oil for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through, then lift out.
Fry the onion in the pan for 5 minutes until golden, add garlic, paprika, tomatoes and paste and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Slice the sausage, return to the gravy and serve over pap.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausage until it reaches 75°C throughout. Check the label for gluten.

recipes.title: Lomi Lomi Hawaiian Poached Salmon and Tomato Plates
recipes.summary: Hawaiian style poached salmon with tomato, onion and cucumber over rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Poach the salmon in simmering salted water for 8 minutes until opaque, flake it and cool.
Toss the tomatoes, onion, cucumber and spring onions with the lime juice, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fold in the salmon and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook salmon until it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers promptly.
